mapper.select: SELECT id, purge_enabled, retention_days, batch_delete_size, optimize_after_purge, archive_write_enabled, last_purge_at, last_purge_deleted_rows, last_purge_duration_ms, updated_by, update_time FROM telemetry_archive_purge_config WHERE id = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO telemetry_archive_purge_config ( id, purge_enabled, retention_days, batch_delete_size, optimize_after_purge, archive_write_enabled, updated_by ) VALUES ( 1, #{cfg.purgeEnabled}, #{cfg.retentionDays}, #{cfg.batchDeleteSize}, #{cfg.optimizeAfterPurge}, #{cfg.archiveWriteEnabled}, #{cfg.updatedBy} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE purge_enabled = VALUES(purge_enabled), retention_days = VALUES(retention_days), batch_delete_size = VALUES(batch_delete_size), optimize_after_purge = VALUES(optimize_after_purge), archive_write_enabled = VALUES(archive_write_enabled), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)
mapper.update: UPDATE telemetry_archive_purge_config SET last_purge_at = NOW(), last_purge_deleted_rows = #{deletedRows}, last_purge_duration_ms = #{durationMs}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = 1
